story_title: As an Event Organiser, I want to view the current status of my event request so that I know how far it has progressed

acceptance_criteria.text: The Event Organiser can view the current status of their event.
The status reflects the latest action performed on the event.
The system displays appropriate statuses such as Submitted, Under Review, Approved, Planning, Confirmed, Completed, Rejected, Postponed, Withdrawn or Cancelled.
The Event Organiser cannot manually change the event status.

test_cases.title: My Events shows each of the organiser's events with its current status badge
test_cases.preconditions:
Test data freshly loaded: run `npm run fixtures:spm27` from the project folder just before this case.
Logged in as Hakim Zulkifli (hakim.zulkifli@bayuenergypa.com / password123), Event Organiser, Bayu Energy Partners.
test_cases.test_data: SPM27 Bayu Safety Briefing: Submitted | SPM27 Bayu Investor Day: Submitted | SPM27 Bayu Town Hall: Submitted | SPM27 Bayu Grid Workshop: Under review | SPM27 Bayu Contractor Briefing: Under review | SPM27 Bayu Supplier Day: Approved | SPM27 Bayu Leadership Retreat: Planning | SPM27 Bayu Annual Conference: Confirmed | SPM27 Bayu Graduate Induction: Completed | SPM27 Bayu Overnight Site Visit: Rejected | SPM27 Bayu Community Fair: Postponed | SPM27 Bayu Partner Lunch: Withdrawn | SPM27 Bayu Wind Farm Tour: Withdrawn | SPM27 Bayu Product Showcase: Cancelled
test_cases.expected_result: Step 1: Each of the 14 SPM27 events shows a coloured status badge with exactly the label listed in Test data, so all 10 statuses appear: Submitted, Under review, Approved, Planning, Confirmed, Completed, Rejected, Postponed, Withdrawn, Cancelled (some on more than one event). No status is shown as a raw value such as 'under_review'. Only Bayu Energy Partners events are listed; no other company's events appear.
